timezone.issue: Maxim UI could render raw timestamps through the browser timezone path; legacy/imported class timestamps can display the wrong wall time if stored as Eastern wall time in UTC form.
timezone.fix: API now returns classDateDisplay and prioritizes explicit wall-time sources before timestamp interpretation: status_detail registered label, then Hot_sync class_date plus start_time, then raw timestamp formatted in America/New_York. docs/corp/maxim.html uses classDateDisplay before falling back to Eastern timestamp formatting.
timezone.direct_registration_storage: easternTimestamp(date, startTime) still converts selected Eastern wall time to the correct UTC instant.

direct_registration.registration_url_behavior: Direct Maxim registrations write registration_url as null; source booking URLs are retained only in source_booking_url for audit context.

standing_order.scope: Simulated Gmail-style/email drafts and reports only.

notes: Existing unrelated public-generation baseline expectation failures

deploy_readiness.reason: Supabase migration and Edge Function changes require review and explicit production deployment approval.
